toolsPreview.name: search_posts
toolsPreview.description: Full-text search across Umesh Malik's blog posts (titles, summaries, tags). Returns matching posts with slug, title, URL, summary, tags and publish date. Use for topics like AI engineering, LLMs, RAG, Claude Code, fine-tuning, or web development.

toolsPreview.name: get_post
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the full Markdown of a blog post by its slug (as returned by search_posts), including frontmatter metadata. Returns clean, agent-readable Markdown.

toolsPreview.name: list_topics
toolsPreview.description: List the curated topic hubs (Claude Code, LLM Engineering, AI Coding Agents) with their URLs.

toolsPreview.name: get_profile
toolsPreview.description: Get Umesh Malik's professional profile — role, experience, skills, projects and contact — as the machine-readable llms.txt index.
